cor.heading: Cost of Sales
cor.text: Cost of sales for the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $37,578 compared with $34,803 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase of $2,775, or 8%, was primarily due to an unfavorable shift in sales mix away from bulk trim, which has a lower average cost per gram over other products.

ga.heading: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
ga.text:
Selling, general and administrative expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $16,142 (24% of sales) compared with $15,599 (23% of sales) for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

Cannabis SG&A increased by approximately $2,890, or 24%, primarily due to higher commercial and marketing expenses and a higher allocation of corporate costs as a result of an update to the Company's transfer pricing policies.

sga.heading: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
sga.text:

nonop.heading: Interest Expense
nonop.text: Interest expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $443 compared with $646 for the three months ended September 30, 2025 due to a decrease in the average debt balance and a decrease in interest rates from the prior year.

pretax.text: Income before taxes for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $13,120 compared with $15,533 for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

net.text: Net income attributable to Village Farms International, Inc. shareholders for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $9,968 compared with $10,217 for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

intro.text: Village Farms is a global leader in cannabis, plant-based consumer packaged goods, and sustainable innovation. With a legacy built on decades of Controlled Environment Agriculture expertise and Dutch farming practices, today the Company is one of the world’s largest and most profitable cannabis operators with an asset portfolio that spans over 7 million square feet of advanced greenhouse and indoor cultivation assets. In Canada, Village Farms operates the world’s largest EU-GMP certified cannabis facility at its production campus in Delta, British Columbia, and exports products to international medical markets. The Company is also a market share leader in dried flower formats and produces and distributes some of the country’s highest quality and best-selling strains, including its flagship Pure Sunfarms Pink Kush, one of the most widely consumed strains on the planet.

lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable

lines.name: Accrued liabilities

lines.name: Accrued compensation

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
